source_semantics.energy_policy: Computes clipped gain times total-energy error; it requests work, not instantaneous power.
source_semantics.mechanical_actuation: Predictor input is held shaft torque; usable candidate interval is bounded.
source_semantics.jacobian: Analytical energy-rate transformation; implementation does not explicitly compute or invert DH.
source_semantics.prediction: Integrate physical f using RK4, then evaluate energy map H; exact flow identities are used for interpretation.
source_semantics.candidate_generation: Uniform bounded torque grid plus bisection refinements where work-error brackets include zero.
source_semantics.candidate_ranking: All finite grid and eligible refined candidates share one potential/work/arm score.
source_semantics.arm_constraint: Finite penalty evaluated at initial state and integration step endpoints, not a hard continuous-time guarantee.
source_semantics.energy_feasibility: Physical image is characterized analytically; no separate energy-state sampling/filtering is implemented.

mathematical_checks.interpretation: An affine plane in R^3. Its physical part is S(e,w). The full plane includes nonphysical triples.

mathematical_checks.conditions: Exact flow of the smooth mechanical dynamics along the predicted trajectory; wrapped angle representations are interpreted through their continuous physical motion.
Constant torque and unwrapped arm angle.
Lossless mechanical model; not an exact conservation identity of finite-step RK4.
Bounded held torque and exact lossless prediction; no-root statement concerns this input family and duration.
P_mech=u*omega and abs(u)<=U; this is not a state-independent power bound.

mathematical_checks.interpretation: Retained square-completion argument gives physical energy existence, not finite-time input reachability.

hardware_review.exact_model: Not specified by author; optional clarification pending. Discussion is explicitly scoped to QUBE-Servo 2 and 3.
hardware_review.verified_interface: Motor voltage command; QUBE-Servo 3 additionally supports a PWM command.
hardware_review.motor_model: Ideal direct-drive relation u approximately k_t*i and v_m approximately R*i+k_e*omega when electrical transients and motor mechanical losses are neglected.
hardware_review.inferred_admissibility: With prescribed allowed current I_max and voltage v_max, the quasi-static model requires abs(u)<=k_t*I_max and abs((R/k_t)*u+k_e*omega)<=v_max along the action. These are explanatory constraints, not an implemented model.
hardware_review.rating_boundary: No nominal voltage, no-load speed, sensor range, or product power label is treated as a complete actuator limit; no device-specific maximum is asserted.
hardware_review.efficiency_boundary: Existing model has no motor voltage, current, winding resistance, electrical storage, or drive loss state. Shaft power equals the modeled total-energy rate. Electrical-to-mechanical efficiency requires additional modeling or measurement.
hardware_review.energy_redistribution_boundary: Potential-energy increase can use stored kinetic energy; potential-energy rate divided by shaft power is not a motor efficiency and can be undefined at zero power.
hardware_review.extension_boundary: A voltage-driven model or speed-dependent torque admissibility changes prediction and the curve; the work-request law and energy-plane construction can remain. Constant voltage does not mean constant torque.

official_sources.supports: Voltage command, current measurement, diagnostic fault and stall conditions; not a maximum-current rating.

Current/back-emf/voltage relation and current-to-torque relation in a DC motor model; general model source, not a QUBE-specific rating.
Direct-drive brushed DC motor and built-in stall/thermal protection.
